# AKCOE Portal

> Official student, lecturer and administration portal for Aminu Kano College of Education (AKCOE), Kano, Nigeria.

AKCOE Portal is the college management system used for course registration, result upload and approval, transcripts, admissions and academic records for NCE and affiliated degree programmes.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the AKCOE Portal for students, lecturers, HODs, deans and registry staff.
